transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because people think I'm focusing too much on things. It's about my father's death. 

I know everyone keeps telling me the hospital records and the donation emails all line up... but they don't. I look at data for a living. When I actually compare the timestamps, and see the missing attachments... and just the way certain community members avoid my questions when I bring it up... it’s obvious to me that someone is hiding what really happened. I'm just trying to get to the bottom of it, but no one wants to listen.
Have you had periods of feeling unusually high, energetic, or irritable?
No. I don't... I haven't noticed anything like that. I just feel normal. I mean, I get frustrated when people ignore the data, but... no. Not unusually high or energetic.
Do you believe with complete certainty that someone is deliberately hiding the truth about your father’s death?

I mean... yes. Like I just said, the data doesn't just change itself. The timestamps, the missing files... and the way people won't look me in the eye when I ask about it. 

I don't know what else to call it. So, yeah... I'm certain.
Have you had any hallucinations, like hearing or seeing things other people do not?
No. ... I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. I just look at the files.
Has this kind of belief or suspicion happened before, in other situations, too?
No. Not really. Just... just this. It's only about the files and what happened to him.
How long have you been convinced that someone is hiding what happened to your father?
About... nine months. Since right after he died. I started going through his records and messages then, and... yeah. About nine months.
Have you noticed any decline in your work, self-care, or ability to function since this started?

No, not really. I mean... I still go to work. I handle my projects just fine. I pay my bills, do the normal stuff. It's just... well, things only really get tense if I try to talk about his records. You know, with my family or people around town. But other than that, no. I'm functioning fine.
If you were shown clear, reliable proof that your father's death was not being covered up, would you be able to accept that?

I... I don't know what "proof" you mean. Everyone keeps telling me that the hospital records and those donation emails all line up perfectly. But... they don't. When I actually look at the timestamps, the missing attachments... and just the way certain people around town avoid looking at me when I ask questions... it's just obvious. I know someone is hiding what really happened. So, no. I wouldn't accept something that isn't true.
Before your father died, had you long been suspicious that other people might be out to harm, deceive, or take advantage of you?
No. I... no. Not at all. I didn't have any reason to be. I just did my job and minded my own business. Things were fine before he passed.
Before your father died, did you generally have trouble trusting other people?
No. I... I trusted people fine. There wasn't any issue with that before.
Outside of your father's death, do you ever feel that other people are watching you or trying to harm you?
No. I don't... nobody is watching me. It's just about my dad. That's all.
Have you always been a suspicious or distrustful person, even before your father died?
I thought I just answered that. No, I haven't always been like that. Like I said, everything was normal before.
